<style>
/* Instant Quote — behavior-only CSS (page head)
 * Layout, grids, borders, typography → Webflow Designer classes only.
 */

:root {
  --iq-bg: #00001c;
  --iq-border: #ffffff;
  --iq-tick-line: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35);
  --iq-tick-mark: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
}

/* ── Slider embeds (HtmlEmbed) ───────────────────────────────────────── */

.iq-slider-control {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: 56px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0 11px;
}

.iq-slider-ticks {
  position: absolute;
  left: 11px;
  right: 11px;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  height: 12px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-end;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 1;
}

.iq-slider-track-line {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  top: 50%;
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--iq-tick-line);
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  z-index: 0;
}

.iq-slider-tick {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  width: 1px;
  height: 8px;
  background: var(--iq-tick-mark);
  flex: 0 0 1px;
}

.iq-range {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  width: 100%;
  height: 56px;
  margin: 0;
  background: transparent;
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  appearance: none;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.iq-range:focus {
  outline: none;
}

.iq-range:focus-visible::-webkit-slider-thumb {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35);
}

.iq-range:focus-visible::-moz-range-thumb {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35);
}

.iq-range::-webkit-slider-runnable-track {
  height: 1px;
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
}

.iq-range::-webkit-slider-thumb {
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  appearance: none;
  width: 22px;
  height: 44px;
  margin-top: -21px;
  border: 2px solid var(--iq-border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--iq-border);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
  transition: transform 0.12s ease;
}

.iq-range:active::-webkit-slider-thumb {
  transform: scaleY(1.04);
}

.iq-range::-moz-range-track {
  height: 1px;
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
}

.iq-range::-moz-range-thumb {
  width: 22px;
  height: 44px;
  border: 2px solid var(--iq-border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--iq-border);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
}

.iq-range::-moz-range-progress {
  background: transparent;
}

.iq-toggle-track .iq-toggle-btn {
  white-space: nowrap;
  text-wrap: nowrap;
}

/* ── Custom check / radio appearance ───────────────────────────────── */

.iq-check {
  appearance: none;
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  min-width: 22px;
  min-height: 22px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  border: 2px solid var(--iq-border);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  position: relative;
  transition: background 0.15s ease;
}

.iq-style-option .iq-check {
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  min-width: 20px;
  min-height: 20px;
}

.iq-check:checked {
  background: var(--iq-border);
}

.iq-check:checked::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  top: 50%;
  width: 5px;
  height: 9px;
  border: solid var(--iq-bg);
  border-width: 0 2px 2px 0;
  transform: translate(-50%, -58%) rotate(45deg);
}

/* ── 50/50 split row + unit cost #2 reveal (JS toggles .is-visible) ─── */

#split-row-wrapper {
  overflow: hidden;
  max-height: 0;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(-10px);
  transition:
    max-height 0.48s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    opacity 0.36s ease,
    transform 0.36s ease;
  pointer-events: none;
  visibility: hidden;
}

#split-row-wrapper.is-visible {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(0);
  pointer-events: auto;
  visibility: visible;
}

#iq-unit-cost-2 {
  overflow: hidden;
  max-height: 0;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(-8px);
  transition:
    max-height 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    opacity 0.3s ease,
    transform 0.3s ease;
  pointer-events: none;
  visibility: hidden;
}

#iq-unit-cost-2.is-visible {
  max-height: 120px;
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(0);
  pointer-events: auto;
  visibility: visible;
}

/* ── Art pricing modal (footer HTML) ───────────────────────────────── */

.iq-modal {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 1000;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 24px;
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity 0.25s ease, visibility 0.25s ease;
}

.iq-modal.is-open {
  opacity: 1;
  visibility: visible;
  pointer-events: auto;
}

.iq-modal-backdrop {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 28, 0.78);
  backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
}

.iq-modal-panel {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  width: min(560px, 100%);
  max-height: min(80vh, 640px);
  overflow: auto;
  border: 1px solid var(--iq-border);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: var(--iq-bg);
  padding: 28px 28px 24px;
  box-shadow: 0 24px 64px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
}

.iq-modal-close {
  position: absolute;
  top: 12px;
  right: 12px;
  appearance: none;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--iq-border);
  font-size: 28px;
  line-height: 1;
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.iq-modal-title {
  margin: 0 32px 16px 0;
  font-size: 24px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.iq-modal-body p {
  margin: 0 0 16px;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.55;
}

.iq-modal-body p:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

/* ── JS-driven form states only ────────────────────────────────────── */

.iq-form-status.is-success {
  color: #6ee7b7;
}

.iq-form-status.is-error {
  color: #fca5a5;
}

.iq-form-upload.is-dragover {
  border-color: #2aaab8;
  background: rgba(42, 170, 184, 0.08);
}

</style>
